statement: Users need reminders ahead of a task's deadline. Add an optional reminder timestamp to each task; it must be saved locally and retain its exact value when read back. Existing installations must retain their current tasks.
To accommodate older clients, the sync server needs to know the app version running on each device. Include the sending client's version in every sync request from both the Android and desktop apps.

Users currently have to wait until an ongoing sync finishes. Allow the app to request cancellation of an active synchronisation through the background service, and make that capability available to the app's sync client. Requesting cancellation when no synchronisation is running must be harmless.

The string that titles the task list screen also supplies the navigation destination's title, making its current resource name misleading. Give the resource a name that clearly identifies it as the list title, update all its uses, and preserve the German translation.

Due dates currently display the UTC calendar day, which can produce the wrong day near midnight for users in other regions. Ensure the shared code knows the device's current UTC offset on every platform and applies it when converting a due date to text.

Completing tasks and then creating more lets users evade the demo edition's task limit. Count completed tasks as well as open tasks toward the demo limit, while continuing to count only open tasks in the full edition.

For tasks without a due date, CSV exports currently put 1970-01-01 in the due column. Leave that column blank for those tasks, preserving all other columns and the behaviour of every other export format.

The version catalog's shared Compose UI library is one feature release out of date. Move it to the next feature release and verify that everything relying on it, including the generated resource accessors used by shared components, still builds for Android and desktop.
At present, background sync starts again only after the phone restarts. It must also start following an update of the app to a new version, without requiring the user to open the app.

Record the app version responsible for the most recent write to every stored preference so stale values can be detected after upgrades. Preserve saved preferences on existing installations and initialise the added version information to an empty value for those preferences.

Task cards currently omit a task's tags. Show them beneath the title with a brief localisable label on every platform using the shared card. Cards for tasks without tags must keep their current appearance.

Checksum calculation for a large export currently copies the entire payload before computing it. Allow the native checksum to operate on an array segment specified by a starting position and a length, and update its callers accordingly.

The product team has changed the highest task priority's name from Urgent to Critical. Apply the rename to the domain model and every place where that priority is displayed, exported, or exchanged, including labels on every screen, the colour resource, exports, and sync. Maintain compatibility with data that was already stored or synced.

Add coverage for the currently untested sync engine case in which the server holds a newer version of a task that is still awaiting upload. The tests must demonstrate that the task is reported as a conflict, is not marked as synced, and retains its local content. Leave production code unchanged.
